items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 158:1
items.html: Malchut has no light of her own, that is, by way of the coupling in her own Partzuf, for the screen has already been refined, and only a root of coarseness remains in it, and therefore it is not sufficient for the aspect of a coupling of striking. And everything she has, she must receive from the coupling made in ZA, her husband. (Item 41).
